answer: The protocol requires each agent to maintain 1,000 unique data shards, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits where failed proof of replication triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash. An honest participant incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times that expense. Like a calm lagoon, this steady pulse of data integrity prevents fraud. Any attempt to hide in shale-like layers of fake data fails.
